DLG-SC-LOC-022-12-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-022-12-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: お料理をお持ちしました。何か必要な物はございますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-022-12-001-SHARED-01.translation: Here is your food. Is there anything else you need?

DLG-SC-LOC-022-12-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-022-12-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 焼き魚の骨を外してから食べたいです。骨を置ける小さな皿をいただけますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-022-12-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 焼魚の骨用小皿を依頼する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-022-12-001-SHARED-02.translation: I'd like to remove the bones from the grilled fish before eating. Could I have a small plate to put the bones on?
DLG-SC-LOC-022-12-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask for a small plate for the grilled fish bones. Please speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-022-12-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-022-12-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 小皿をお持ちします。大きいお皿の横に置きましょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-022-12-001-SHARED-03.translation: I'll bring a small plate. Shall I place it beside the large plate?

DLG-SC-LOC-022-12-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-022-12-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: はい、右側へお願いします。左側にはご飯があるので、そこは空けておきたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-022-12-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: ご飯を避け右側配置を希望する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-022-12-001-SHARED-04.translation: Yes, on the right, please. My rice is on the left, so I'd like to keep that area clear.
DLG-SC-LOC-022-12-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Ask for placement on the right, away from the rice. Please speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-022-12-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-022-12-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: お飲み物のおかわりは必要でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-022-12-001-SHARED-05.translation: Would you like a refill of your drink?

DLG-SC-LOC-022-12-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-022-12-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 水を少しいただきたいです。コップをいっぱいにせず、半分くらいでお願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-022-12-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 水をコップ半分希望する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-022-12-001-SHARED-06.translation: I'd like a little water. Please fill the glass only about halfway rather than to the top.
DLG-SC-LOC-022-12-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask for half a glass of water. Please speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-022-12-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-022-12-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 半分ほどお入れします。ほかにお手伝いしましょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-022-12-001-SHARED-07.translation: I'll fill it about halfway. Is there anything else I can help with?

DLG-SC-LOC-022-12-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-022-12-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 魚の皿が熱いので、奥へ少し動かすのをお願いできますか。自分で持ち上げると落としそうです。
DLG-SC-LOC-022-12-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 熱い皿を奥へ動かす手伝いを頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-022-12-001-SHARED-08.translation: The fish plate is hot. Could you help move it a little farther back? I feel I might drop it if I lift it myself.
DLG-SC-LOC-022-12-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ask for help moving the hot plate farther back. Please speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-022-12-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-022-12-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: こちらへ動かします。小皿へ手が届きますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-022-12-001-SHARED-09.translation: I'll move it here. Can you reach the small plate?

DLG-SC-LOC-022-12-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-022-12-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 届きます。骨は小皿へ置き、食べ終わったらまとめて下げてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-022-12-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 配置を確認し食後まとめて片付けを希望する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-022-12-001-SHARED-10.translation: Yes, I can. I'll put the bones on the small plate, and please clear everything together after I've finished eating.
DLG-SC-LOC-022-12-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Confirm the arrangement and ask for everything to be cleared together after the meal. Please speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-022-12-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-022-12-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 配置できました。それでは、お口に合いますように。ごゆっくりお召し上がりください。
DLG-SC-LOC-022-12-001-SHARED-11.translation: Everything is in place. I hope the food is to your liking. Please enjoy your meal at your leisure.

DLG-SC-LOC-022-13-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-022-13-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 松林をご覧になる予定ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-022-13-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you planning to see the pine grove?

DLG-SC-LOC-022-13-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-022-13-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。友人と歩きますが、今日は二十分だけです。長く回る前に、この場所について短い説明を聞きたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-022-13-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 二十分散策前の短い景観説明を依頼する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-022-13-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. I'll walk with a friend, but we only have twenty minutes today. Before taking a longer look around, I'd like a brief explanation of this place.
DLG-SC-LOC-022-13-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask for a brief explanation of the scenery before a twenty-minute walk. Please speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-022-13-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-022-13-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: まず案内板の前で、景観の見方をご説明できます。
DLG-SC-LOC-022-13-001-SHARED-03.translation: I can first explain how to appreciate the scenery in front of the information board.

DLG-SC-LOC-022-13-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-022-13-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: お願いします。海の方へ歩き出す前に、案内板の絵と今見える景色を見比べたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-022-13-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 案内板と景色を出発前に比較したいと話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-022-13-001-SHARED-04.translation: Please do. Before we start walking toward the sea, I'd like to compare the picture on the board with the scenery we can see now.
DLG-SC-LOC-022-13-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say you want to compare the information board and scenery before setting off. Please speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-022-13-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-022-13-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: こちらの絵は、松林と海の位置を示しています。
DLG-SC-LOC-022-13-001-SHARED-05.translation: This picture shows the positions of the pine grove and the sea.

DLG-SC-LOC-022-13-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-022-13-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 位置が分かりました。友人は写真を撮りたいので、私は説明をメモし、あとで二人で見せ合います。
DLG-SC-LOC-022-13-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 本人メモ友人写真を後で共有すると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-022-13-001-SHARED-06.translation: I understand where they are now. My friend wants to take photos, so I'll take notes on the explanation, and we'll share them with each other later.
DLG-SC-LOC-022-13-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you will take notes, your friend will take photos, and you will share them later. Please speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-022-13-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-022-13-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 今日の歩く範囲も、ここで決めておかれますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-022-13-001-SHARED-07.translation: Would you also like to decide here how far you will walk today?

DLG-SC-LOC-022-13-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-022-13-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: はい。案内板から見えるところまでにして、遠くの場所は次の機会にします。
DLG-SC-LOC-022-13-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 案内板から見える範囲のみ歩くと決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-022-13-001-SHARED-08.translation: Yes. We'll stay within the area visible from the information board and leave the distant places for another time.
DLG-SC-LOC-022-13-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Decide to walk only within the area visible from the information board. Please speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-022-13-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-022-13-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: ご案内は以上です。お戻りになる場所は分かりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-022-13-001-SHARED-09.translation: That concludes my explanation. Do you know where to return?

DLG-SC-LOC-022-13-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-022-13-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: この案内板を戻る目印にします。二人ともここへ戻ってから出発することを確認しました。
DLG-SC-LOC-022-13-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 案内板に二人で戻り出発すると確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-022-13-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll use this information board as the landmark for returning. We've confirmed that we will both return here before leaving.
DLG-SC-LOC-022-13-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Confirm that you will both return to the information board before leaving. Please speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-022-13-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-022-13-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: それでは、短い散策をお楽しみください。風景をゆっくりご覧になって、お気をつけて。
DLG-SC-LOC-022-13-001-SHARED-11.translation: Enjoy your short walk, then. Take your time appreciating the scenery, and take care.

DLG-SC-LOC-022-14-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-022-14-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 方角の表示をご覧でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-022-14-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you looking at the direction signs?

DLG-SC-LOC-022-14-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-022-14-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 家族へ今日の景色を手紙で伝えたいです。山の見えた方向を、ここにある表示で確認できますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-022-14-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 家族への手紙用に山の見えた方角を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-022-14-001-SHARED-02.translation: I'd like to describe today's scenery in a letter to my family. Can I use the signs here to check the direction where I saw the mountains?
DLG-SC-LOC-022-14-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Check the direction where you saw the mountains for a letter to your family. Please speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-022-14-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-022-14-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: こちらに方角の案内があります。どの窓からご覧になりましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-022-14-001-SHARED-03.translation: The direction guide is here. Which window did you look through?

DLG-SC-LOC-022-14-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-022-14-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: この窓です。景色の写真は撮りましたが、方角の表示を入れ忘れました。
DLG-SC-LOC-022-14-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 見た窓と表示を撮り忘れた写真を示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-022-14-001-SHARED-04.translation: This window. I took a photo of the scenery, but forgot to include the direction sign.
DLG-SC-LOC-022-14-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Show the window you looked through and the photo that lacks the sign. Please speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-022-14-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-022-14-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: この案内では、山の見えた窓は北側と記されています。写真の向きと照らしてみましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-022-14-001-SHARED-05.translation: This guide labels the window where you saw the mountains as the north side. Let's compare it with the direction of the photo.

DLG-SC-LOC-022-14-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-022-14-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 同じ向きが分かりました。表示を短くメモし、写真と一緒に残します。
DLG-SC-LOC-022-14-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 写真と照合した方角をメモすると話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-022-14-001-SHARED-06.translation: I've identified the matching direction. I'll briefly note what the sign says and keep it with the photo.
DLG-SC-LOC-022-14-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you will note the direction checked against your photo. Please speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-022-14-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-022-14-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: ほかに、見つけたい景色はございますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-022-14-001-SHARED-07.translation: Is there any other scenery you would like to find?

DLG-SC-LOC-022-14-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-022-14-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 友人が海を見たいと言っています。私はメモを終えてから一緒に回りたいので、次に見る方向を相談します。
DLG-SC-LOC-022-14-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 友人と次に海を見る方向を相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-022-14-001-SHARED-08.translation: My friend says they want to see the sea. I'd like to finish my notes and then look around together, so I'd like to discuss which direction to look next.
DLG-SC-LOC-022-14-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Discuss with your friend which direction to look next to see the sea. Please speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-022-14-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-022-14-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 海を見る窓は南側と表示されています。南側の表示へ進んで、景色をお確かめください。
DLG-SC-LOC-022-14-001-SHARED-09.translation: The window for viewing the sea is marked as the south side. Follow the south-side sign and check the scenery.

DLG-SC-LOC-022-14-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-022-14-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。まず方角のメモをしまい、友人と次の窓へ移ります。手紙には自分が見た順に書きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-022-14-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: メモ後次窓へ移り見た順に手紙を書くと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-022-14-001-SHARED-10.translation: Thank you. I'll put away my direction notes first, then move to the next window with my friend. In my letter, I'll describe things in the order I saw them.
DLG-SC-LOC-022-14-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will move to the next window after making your notes and write the letter in the order you saw things. Please speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-022-14-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-022-14-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: どうぞ次の景色もご覧ください。素敵なお手紙になりますように。ご来館ありがとうございます。
DLG-SC-LOC-022-14-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please enjoy the next view too. I hope you write a lovely letter. Thank you for visiting.

DLG-SC-LOC-022-15-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-022-15-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: お茶は二種類をご注文になりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-022-15-001-SHARED-01.translation: Would you like to order two kinds of tea?

DLG-SC-LOC-022-15-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-022-15-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 飲み比べたいです。ただ、同時に置くとどちらを飲んだか混ざりそうなので、一杯ずつ頼めますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-022-15-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 茶飲比べを一杯ずつ注文できるか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-022-15-001-SHARED-02.translation: I'd like to compare them. But if they're served together, I might lose track of which one I've drunk. May I order one cup at a time?
DLG-SC-LOC-022-15-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask whether you can order the teas one cup at a time for comparison. Please speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-022-15-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-022-15-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 先に一種類お出しして、次はお声がけいただいてからご用意できます。
DLG-SC-LOC-022-15-001-SHARED-03.translation: We can serve one kind first, then prepare the next when you ask us.

DLG-SC-LOC-022-15-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-022-15-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: では、香りが軽い方を先にお願いします。次の注文は、それを飲み終えてからにします。
DLG-SC-LOC-022-15-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 軽い香りの茶を先に次は飲後と依頼する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-022-15-001-SHARED-04.translation: Then please bring the one with the lighter fragrance first. I'll order the next after finishing that one.
DLG-SC-LOC-022-15-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Ask for the lightly fragrant tea first and the next only after drinking it. Please speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-022-15-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-022-15-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: お菓子は、最初のお茶と一緒にいたしますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-022-15-001-SHARED-05.translation: Shall we serve the sweet with the first tea?

DLG-SC-LOC-022-15-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-022-15-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: はい。一つを半分ずつ食べたいので、友人用の小皿もお願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-022-15-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 菓子共有用に小皿を求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-022-15-001-SHARED-06.translation: Yes. We'd like to split one into halves, so please bring a small plate for my friend too.
DLG-SC-LOC-022-15-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask for a small plate for sharing the sweet. Please speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-022-15-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-022-15-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 承知しました。最初のお茶について、名前もお伝えします。
DLG-SC-LOC-022-15-001-SHARED-07.translation: Certainly. I'll also tell you the name of the first tea.

DLG-SC-LOC-022-15-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-022-15-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。名前をメモしてから飲みます。友人には、自分の感じた香りを聞いてみます。
DLG-SC-LOC-022-15-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 茶名を控え友人の香り感想を聞くと話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-022-15-001-SHARED-08.translation: Thank you. I'll write down the name before drinking. I'll ask my friend what they personally thought of the fragrance.
DLG-SC-LOC-022-15-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you will note the tea's name and ask your friend for their impression of its fragrance. Please speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-022-15-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-022-15-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 次のお茶も、準備できるものをご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-022-15-001-SHARED-09.translation: For the next tea too, we'll explain what we can prepare.

DLG-SC-LOC-022-15-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-022-15-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: お願いします。最初のカップを下げてもらってから次を頼み、二つの感想を別々に残します。
DLG-SC-LOC-022-15-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 旧杯片付け後次注文し感想を別記すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-022-15-001-SHARED-10.translation: Please do. I'll have the first cup cleared before ordering the next and keep separate notes on my impressions of the two.
DLG-SC-LOC-022-15-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will order the next tea after the previous cup is cleared and record your impressions separately. Please speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-022-15-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-022-15-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: それでは、まず一杯目をお楽しみください。お声がけをお待ちしております。ありがとうございます。
DLG-SC-LOC-022-15-001-SHARED-11.translation: For now, please enjoy your first cup. Let us know when you're ready. Thank you.

DLG-SC-LOC-022-16-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-022-16-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 清掃のお手伝いにいらしたのですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-022-16-001-SHARED-01.translation: Have you come to help with the cleaning?

DLG-SC-LOC-022-16-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-022-16-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。友人との約束まで三十分あるので、その間だけ参加したいです。短い時間でできることはありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-022-16-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 約束まで三十分の短時間清掃参加を希望する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-022-16-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. I have thirty minutes before meeting a friend, so I'd like to join in just for that time. Is there something I can do in a short time?
DLG-SC-LOC-022-16-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask to join the cleaning for the thirty minutes before your appointment. Please speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-022-16-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-022-16-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: この辺りの落ち葉を袋へ集める作業でしたら、少しずつ進めていただけます。
DLG-SC-LOC-022-16-001-SHARED-03.translation: You could make progress little by little collecting the fallen leaves around here into a bag.

DLG-SC-LOC-022-16-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-022-16-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: お願いします。広い範囲を一人で終わらせるのでなく、このベンチの前から始めます。
DLG-SC-LOC-022-16-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: ベンチ前の限定範囲から始めると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-022-16-001-SHARED-04.translation: I'd like to do that. Rather than trying to finish a large area alone, I'll start in front of this bench.
DLG-SC-LOC-022-16-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say you will start with the limited area in front of the bench. Please speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-022-16-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-022-16-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: こちらの袋と、作業用の手袋をお使いください。
DLG-SC-LOC-022-16-001-SHARED-05.translation: Please use this bag and these work gloves.

DLG-SC-LOC-022-16-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-022-16-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。自分の鞄は背負ったままにし、袋を持って集めます。終わる前に、誰に声を掛ければよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-022-16-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 袋手袋を受け取り終了時の報告相手を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-022-16-001-SHARED-06.translation: Thank you. I'll keep my own bag on my back and hold the collection bag as I gather the leaves. Who should I speak to before finishing?
DLG-SC-LOC-022-16-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Receive the bag and gloves and ask whom to report to when finishing. Please speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-022-16-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-022-16-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 私へお知らせください。途中までの袋はこちらで引き継ぎます。
DLG-SC-LOC-022-16-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please let me know. We'll take over the bag even if it's only partly filled.

DLG-SC-LOC-022-16-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-022-16-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 分かりました。出発する五分前に集めるのをやめて、袋の場所と終わった範囲をお伝えします。
DLG-SC-LOC-022-16-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 五分前に止め袋位置と完了範囲を知らせると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-022-16-001-SHARED-08.translation: Understood. I'll stop collecting five minutes before I leave and tell you where the bag is and which area I've finished.
DLG-SC-LOC-022-16-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you will stop five minutes before departure and report the bag's location and completed area. Please speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-022-16-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-022-16-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 今はまだお時間がありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-022-16-001-SHARED-09.translation: Do you still have time now?

DLG-SC-LOC-022-16-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-022-16-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: あと十分あります。このベンチの前の分を集めたら、続きはせず、今の袋を持って報告に戻ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-022-16-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 残り十分で区切りを終え袋を持って報告すると話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-022-16-001-SHARED-10.translation: I have ten minutes left. Once I've collected the leaves in front of this bench, I won't continue further; I'll bring the current bag back and report to you.
DLG-SC-LOC-022-16-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that with ten minutes left, you will finish this section and return with the bag to report. Please speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-022-16-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-022-16-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: ご協力ありがとうございます。それでは、残りの時間も無理なくお願いします。お約束にもお気をつけてお出かけください。
DLG-SC-LOC-022-16-001-SHARED-11.translation: Thank you for helping. Please work comfortably for the remaining time too. Take care as you go to meet your friend.

DLG-SC-LOC-022-17-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-022-17-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: お着替えの袋をお持ちですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-022-17-001-SHARED-01.translation: You have a bag of clothes to change into, I see.

DLG-SC-LOC-022-17-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-022-17-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。入浴したあと友人と休みたいですが、着替えをどこに置くと帰るとき取りやすいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-022-17-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 入浴後休憩に備え着替袋の置場を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-022-17-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. I'd like to relax with a friend after bathing. Where should I put the clothes so they're easy to collect when I leave?
DLG-SC-LOC-022-17-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask where to place your change-of-clothes bag before resting after your bath. Please speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-022-17-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-022-17-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: この受付でお預かりする物と、ご自身で管理する物をご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-022-17-001-SHARED-03.translation: We'll explain which things we can keep at reception and which you need to look after yourself.

DLG-SC-LOC-022-17-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-022-17-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 貴重品は小さい袋に分けています。着替えの袋だけについて、使える置き場所を教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-022-17-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 貴重品を分け着替袋のみ案内を求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-022-17-001-SHARED-04.translation: I've separated my valuables into a small bag. Please tell me about a place I can use just for my change-of-clothes bag.
DLG-SC-LOC-022-17-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Separate your valuables and ask for guidance only about the change-of-clothes bag. Please speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-022-17-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-022-17-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: こちらの荷物置きをご利用いただけます。ほかの方の物と分かる目印はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-022-17-001-SHARED-05.translation: You can use this luggage storage area. Does your bag have a distinguishing mark so you can tell it apart from others?

DLG-SC-LOC-022-17-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-022-17-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 持ち手に黄色いひもを結んでいます。友人の袋は同じ色ですが、私のはこのひもがあります。
DLG-SC-LOC-022-17-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 同色友人袋との黄色ひも目印を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-022-17-001-SHARED-06.translation: I've tied a yellow cord to the handle. My friend's bag is the same color, but mine has this cord.
DLG-SC-LOC-022-17-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Explain the yellow cord that distinguishes your bag from your friend's bag of the same color. Please speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-022-17-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-022-17-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 休憩のあと、こちらへ戻ってお取りください。
DLG-SC-LOC-022-17-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please come back here after resting to collect it.

DLG-SC-LOC-022-17-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-022-17-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 分かりました。友人には先に外へ行かず、二人で荷物を取ってから出ると伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-022-17-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 休憩後二人で荷物を取って退出すると話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-022-17-001-SHARED-08.translation: Understood. I'll tell my friend not to go outside first and that we'll both collect our bags before leaving.
DLG-SC-LOC-022-17-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you will both collect your bags after resting and then leave. Please speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-022-17-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-022-17-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 今のうちに、中身をお確かめください。

DLG-SC-LOC-022-17-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-022-17-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: タオルと着替えが入っています。今着ている服は入浴後この袋へ戻し、帰る前にひもを目印に取ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-022-17-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: タオル着替確認と旧衣類を戻す手順を述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-022-17-001-SHARED-10.translation: It contains a towel and a change of clothes. After bathing, I'll put the clothes I'm wearing now into this bag, then use the cord to identify it before leaving.
DLG-SC-LOC-022-17-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Check your towel and change of clothes and explain the procedure for putting your worn clothes back in the bag. Please speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-022-17-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-022-17-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: それでは、置き場所をご案内します。どうぞゆっくりおくつろぎください。ありがとうございます。
DLG-SC-LOC-022-17-001-SHARED-11.translation: I'll show you where to put it, then. Please take your time relaxing. Thank you.

DLG-SC-LOC-022-18-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-022-18-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: お部屋でお困りのことはございますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-022-18-001-SHARED-01.translation: Is there anything troubling you in your room?

DLG-SC-LOC-022-18-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-022-18-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 二人で明日の面接の準備をしたいです。机が一つなので、椅子をもう一脚借りられますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-022-18-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 二人面接準備用の追加椅子を頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-022-18-001-SHARED-02.translation: The two of us want to prepare for tomorrow's interviews. There's one desk, so may we borrow one more chair?
DLG-SC-LOC-022-18-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask for an additional chair so two people can prepare for interviews. Please speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-022-18-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-022-18-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: お部屋へ追加できる椅子があるか確認します。大きな荷物もお持ちですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-022-18-001-SHARED-03.translation: I'll check whether there's a chair we can add to your room. Do you also have large luggage?

DLG-SC-LOC-022-18-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-022-18-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: スーツケースが二つあります。机の下へ入れず、壁際に寄せれば椅子を置けそうです。
DLG-SC-LOC-022-18-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: スーツケースを壁際へ動かす配置を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-022-18-001-SHARED-04.translation: We have two suitcases. If we move them beside the wall instead of under the desk, there should be space for a chair.
DLG-SC-LOC-022-18-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain an arrangement with the suitcases moved beside the wall. Please speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-022-18-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-022-18-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 追加の椅子を一脚お届けできます。机の周りを空けてお待ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-022-18-001-SHARED-05.translation: We can deliver one additional chair. Please clear the area around the desk and wait.

DLG-SC-LOC-022-18-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-022-18-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: お願いします。椅子が来る前に荷物を移し、友人とどちら側に座るか決めます。
DLG-SC-LOC-022-18-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 椅子前に荷物移動と座る側を決めると話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-022-18-001-SHARED-06.translation: Please do. Before the chair arrives, we'll move the luggage and decide with my friend which side each of us will sit on.
DLG-SC-LOC-022-18-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you will move the luggage and decide which side to sit on before the chair arrives. Please speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-022-18-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-022-18-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 照明やコンセントは、お使いになりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-022-18-001-SHARED-07.translation: Will you be using the lighting or power outlets?

DLG-SC-LOC-022-18-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-022-18-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 二人とも紙の書類だけなので、充電は要りません。机の照明を点けて、読みやすさを確かめます。
DLG-SC-LOC-022-18-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 紙書類のみで机照明を試すと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-022-18-001-SHARED-08.translation: Both of us only have paper documents, so we don't need to charge anything. We'll turn on the desk light and check whether it's easy to read.
DLG-SC-LOC-022-18-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you only have paper documents and will try the desk light. Please speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-022-18-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-022-18-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 準備が終わったあとも、通り道を空けてお使いください。
DLG-SC-LOC-022-18-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please keep the passage clear even after you've finished preparing.

DLG-SC-LOC-022-18-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-022-18-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: はい。書類を広げるのは机だけにし、寝る前にまとめます。椅子が届いたら二人で練習を始めます。
DLG-SC-LOC-022-18-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 机のみ使用し就寝前に書類を片付けると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-022-18-001-SHARED-10.translation: Yes. We'll spread documents only on the desk and gather them up before going to bed. Once the chair arrives, we'll start practicing together.
DLG-SC-LOC-022-18-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will use only the desk and put the documents away before bed. Please speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-022-18-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-022-18-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: それでは、お部屋へお届けします。明日のご準備がうまく進みますように。失礼いたします。
DLG-SC-LOC-022-18-001-SHARED-11.translation: We'll bring it to your room, then. I hope your preparations for tomorrow go well. Goodbye.

DLG-SC-LOC-022-19-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-022-19-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: そのメモは、今日ご覧になる動物の記録ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-022-19-001-SHARED-01.translation: Is that note a record of the animals you're seeing today?

DLG-SC-LOC-022-19-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-022-19-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。学校へ持っていくので、最初に見た動物の名前を書きたいです。この展示の表示を確認できますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-022-19-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 学校提出用観察メモの展示名を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-022-19-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. I'll take it to school, so I'd like to write the name of the first animal I saw. May I check the sign for this exhibit?
DLG-SC-LOC-022-19-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Check the exhibit name for observation notes to take to school. Please speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-022-19-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-022-19-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: こちらはレッサーパンダの展示です。表示で名前を確認できます。書くために立ち止まるなら、脇へ寄っていただけます。
DLG-SC-LOC-022-19-001-SHARED-03.translation: This is the red panda exhibit. You can check its name on the sign. If you stop to write, please move to the side.

DLG-SC-LOC-022-19-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-022-19-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: レッサーパンダですね。脇へ移って名前を一文字ずつ写します。友人には先に次へ行かず、少し待ってもらいます。
DLG-SC-LOC-022-19-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: レッサーパンダ名を確認し脇で写す間友人へ待機を頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-022-19-001-SHARED-04.translation: A red panda, then. I'll move aside and copy the name one character at a time. I'll ask my friend to wait a little rather than go ahead to the next exhibit.
DLG-SC-LOC-022-19-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Confirm the red panda's name and ask your friend to wait while you copy it at the side. Please speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-022-19-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-022-19-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: ご覧になったことも、メモに残されますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-022-19-001-SHARED-05.translation: Will you also record what you observed?

DLG-SC-LOC-022-19-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-022-19-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 今日は餌を食べるところを見ました。動物の名前の下に、その様子を短く書きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-022-19-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 食事の様子を名前の下へ書くと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-022-19-001-SHARED-06.translation: Today I saw it eating. I'll briefly write what that looked like beneath the animal's name.
DLG-SC-LOC-022-19-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you will describe the eating behavior below the name. Please speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-022-19-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-022-19-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 展示の前で、またご覧になってから書いても構いません。
DLG-SC-LOC-022-19-001-SHARED-07.translation: You may watch it again in front of the exhibit before writing.

DLG-SC-LOC-022-19-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-022-19-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: もう一度見ます。口の動きが見えたら、絵でも描いてみたいです。写真を撮るより覚えやすそうです。
DLG-SC-LOC-022-19-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 再観察で口の動きを絵にしたいと話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-022-19-001-SHARED-08.translation: I'll take another look. If I can see its mouth moving, I'd like to draw that too. I think it will help me remember better than taking a photo.
DLG-SC-LOC-022-19-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you want to observe again and draw the mouth movements. Please speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-022-19-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-022-19-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: ほかの方にも、見る場所を譲り合ってください。
DLG-SC-LOC-022-19-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please share the viewing space with other visitors too.

DLG-SC-LOC-022-19-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-022-19-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: はい。名前を控えたので、一度メモをしまいます。友人と見てから、広い所へ戻って絵を描きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-022-19-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: メモ収納後友人と観察し広場で描くと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-022-19-001-SHARED-10.translation: Yes. I've noted the name, so I'll put the notes away for now. After watching with my friend, I'll return to a spacious area to draw.
DLG-SC-LOC-022-19-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will put away your notes, observe with your friend, and draw in a spacious area. Please speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-022-19-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-022-19-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: それでは、観察をお楽しみください。よい記録になりますように。ご来園ありがとうございます。
DLG-SC-LOC-022-19-001-SHARED-11.translation: Enjoy observing, then. I hope you make a good record. Thank you for visiting the zoo.

DLG-SC-LOC-022-20-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-022-20-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 今日使う道具は、もう受け取りましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-022-20-001-SHARED-01.translation: Have you already collected the tools you will use today?

DLG-SC-LOC-022-20-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-022-20-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: まだです。私と同僚が同じ物を取りに行くところだったので、どちらが担当するか今決めたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-022-20-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 重複しそうな道具受取担当を決めたいと相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-022-20-001-SHARED-02.translation: Not yet. My colleague and I were both about to collect the same things, so I'd like to decide now which of us will do it.
DLG-SC-LOC-022-20-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask to decide who will collect the tools to avoid doing it twice. Please speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-022-20-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-022-20-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 今日は、あなたが受け取り、同僚は置き場所を準備してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-022-20-001-SHARED-03.translation: Today, you collect them and your colleague should prepare the storage location.

DLG-SC-LOC-022-20-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-022-20-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 分かりました。私が取りに行きます。同僚には、受け取りには行かず準備を続けるよう伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-022-20-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 本人受取同僚準備の分担を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-022-20-001-SHARED-04.translation: Understood. I'll go and collect them. I'll tell my colleague to continue preparing instead of going to collect them too.
DLG-SC-LOC-022-20-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain the division of work: you collect the tools and your colleague prepares. Please speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-022-20-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-022-20-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 道具の数は、こちらの一覧にあります。
DLG-SC-LOC-022-20-001-SHARED-05.translation: The tool quantities are on this list.

DLG-SC-LOC-022-20-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-022-20-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: この一覧を持って受け取ります。両手で運ぶ物もあるので、いったん少ない分から運んでもよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-022-20-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 一覧持参し少量から運べるか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-022-20-001-SHARED-06.translation: I'll take this list when I collect them. Some things need both hands to carry, so may I start by carrying a smaller quantity?
DLG-SC-LOC-022-20-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you will bring the list and ask whether you can carry a small quantity first. Please speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-022-20-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-022-20-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 運ぶ順番を担当者と確認してください。無理に一度で全部運ばなくて構いません。
DLG-SC-LOC-022-20-001-SHARED-07.translation: Check the order for carrying them with the person responsible. You don't have to force yourself to carry everything at once.

DLG-SC-LOC-022-20-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-022-20-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: はい。運搬する前に担当者へ声を掛け、二回に分けることを相談します。
DLG-SC-LOC-022-20-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 担当者へ二回運搬を相談すると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-022-20-001-SHARED-08.translation: Yes. Before carrying them, I'll speak to the person responsible and discuss making two trips.
DLG-SC-LOC-022-20-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you will discuss two trips with the person responsible. Please speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-022-20-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-022-20-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 全部そろったら、こちらへ報告してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-022-20-001-SHARED-09.translation: Once everything is there, please report back here.

DLG-SC-LOC-022-20-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-022-20-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 置き場所へ運んだ数を同僚と数えます。一覧の分がそろったら、受け取りが終わったと報告します。
DLG-SC-LOC-022-20-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 同僚と数照合し全数そろって報告すると話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-022-20-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll count the items brought to the storage location with my colleague. Once all the listed items are there, I'll report that collection is complete.
DLG-SC-LOC-022-20-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will check the quantities with your colleague and report once everything is there. Please speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-022-20-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-022-20-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: それでは、まず担当者へお声がけください。今日もよろしくお願いします。気をつけて作業してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-022-20-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please speak to the person responsible first, then. Thank you for your work today. Work carefully.

DLG-SC-LOC-022-21-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-022-21-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: ご自分の画面でも、同じ操作を試されますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-022-21-001-SHARED-01.translation: Would you like to try the same operation on your own screen?

DLG-SC-LOC-022-21-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-022-21-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。説明だけだと覚えられないので、自分の携帯で最初の画面へ戻る操作を練習したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-022-21-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 携帯で最初の画面へ戻る練習を希望する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-022-21-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. I can't remember from explanations alone, so I'd like to practice returning to the first screen on my own phone.
DLG-SC-LOC-022-21-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask to practice returning to the first screen on your phone. Please speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-022-21-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-022-21-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: この画面の、戻る矢印を押してみてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-022-21-001-SHARED-03.translation: Try pressing the back arrow on this screen.

DLG-SC-LOC-022-21-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-022-21-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 戻れました。二回押すと最初の画面になるので、今の操作を紙に二つの矢印で書きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-022-21-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 二回矢印操作を確認し図で控えると話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-022-21-001-SHARED-04.translation: I went back. Pressing it twice gets me to the first screen, so I'll draw two arrows on paper to note the steps I just took.
DLG-SC-LOC-022-21-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Confirm the two back-arrow presses and say you will draw them as a note. Please speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-022-21-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-022-21-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 今度は、案内のページを開いてみましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-022-21-001-SHARED-05.translation: Now let's try opening the information page.

DLG-SC-LOC-022-21-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-022-21-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: この案内ですね。文字を大きくしてから読みたいので、先に表示の調節を聞いてもよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-022-21-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 案内頁を特定し文字表示調整を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-022-21-001-SHARED-06.translation: This information, right? I'd like to enlarge the text before reading, so may I ask how to adjust the display first?
DLG-SC-LOC-022-21-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Identify the information page and ask how to adjust the text display. Please speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-022-21-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-022-21-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 表示を調節する場所はこちらです。読みやすい大きさへ変えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-022-21-001-SHARED-07.translation: Here is where you adjust the display. Change it to a size that's easy to read.

DLG-SC-LOC-022-21-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-022-21-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: この大きさで読めます。家でも戻せるよう、変える前と後を短くメモしておきます。
DLG-SC-LOC-022-21-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 調整前後を記して自宅で戻せるようにする。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-022-21-001-SHARED-08.translation: I can read it at this size. I'll briefly note the settings before and after the change so I can restore them at home too.
DLG-SC-LOC-022-21-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Note the settings before and after adjustment so you can restore them at home. Please speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-022-21-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-022-21-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 最後に、最初の画面へ戻れますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-022-21-001-SHARED-09.translation: Finally, can you return to the first screen?

DLG-SC-LOC-022-21-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-022-21-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: はい。二回戻って、この画面になりました。今日は練習したメモを持ち帰り、家で案内を読みます。
DLG-SC-LOC-022-21-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 開始画面へ戻れたと示しメモを持帰ると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-022-21-001-SHARED-10.translation: Yes. I went back twice and reached this screen. Today I'll take my practice notes home and read the information there.
DLG-SC-LOC-022-21-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Show that you returned to the starting screen and say you will take the notes home. Please speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-022-21-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-022-21-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 操作を確認できました。それでは、メモと携帯をお忘れなく。ご来店ありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-022-21-001-SHARED-11.translation: We've confirmed the steps. Please don't forget your notes or your phone. Thank you for visiting our store.
